text_block_list.text:
At dusk. On the way back from buying
training equipment with Narita Top Road—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what is that?
There's a crowd gathering up ahead..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Could there be a sale going on? If there's something
good and cheap, maybe we should buy it ahead of time--

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting lottery draw!
Oh, isn't that Top Road-chan right over there?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Looking sharp as always!
How about it, wanna try the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the compliment.
I see, so it was from the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we have a raffle ticket, don't we?
The one we got just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... we got those while shopping with Tracen Academy's budget, so we shouldn't be using them ourselves, right?
choice_data_list: No, it's no problem at all.

text_block_list.text:
"In cases like this, it was left entirely
to the Trainer's discretion to handle as they saw fit."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Then, so as not to waste the chance given to us, let's draw as good a one as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you lend me a hand?
I want to combine our luck.

Nodding, you grip the raffle wheel handle together with Narita Top Road.
And then――

Rhythmically turn it a few times!
Now, what will the result be!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: The grand prize is a "Hot Spring Trip Voucher"...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No, um...
choice_data_list: It's a jackpot, isn't it, Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there's no way that's true, right?
I mean..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've almost never been able to show incredible luck
in these kinds of all-or-nothing moments.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "She always falls just one step short, though. Whaaaat...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I won... the Grand Prize...?
I... really...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"So you're not lying. It's really true.
Then...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Thank you so much!
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Unexpected good fortune...
feels this wonderful, doesn't it?

Suddenly, Narita Top Road rejoices with overwhelming joy.
She seemed bewildered by the unaccustomed stroke of good luck.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful, but... I feel kind of unsettled.
Part of me wishes I could always be blessed with such good fortune, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I keep struggling with the feeling that being blessed like this
will only ruin me... Uuu~."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, that's right!
It's the grand prize, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still... as I thought, I can't just casually accept it.
This hot springs trip is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to think of it as a 'reward'
for trying my best and seeing it through!"
choice_data_list: So you're not going right away?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I will go after standing atop the summit I aim to reach.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise,
I don't think I could truly enjoy it from the bottom of my heart."

"Ever serious, Narita Top Road.
It seems she truly cannot accept
a reward while only halfway along the road."
choice_data_list: Alright, then let's go once we wrap things up here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm sorry for being troublesome. But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I believe it will be infinitely more fun
after we seize glory.
For Trainer's sake as well, I'll definitely do it!"

—A hot springs trip.
With a little soothing comfort alongside her grand dream, Narita Top Road continued forward.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak!
Out of all the realistic possibilities,
you pulled the absolute best one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Since the grand prize is a pipe dream,
I pushed myself to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Carrot hamburger steaks are wonderful, aren't they?
To tell you the truth...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I actually respect them a little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mean that in a weird way, okay?
I just think your nutritional balance is amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I wish I could run like this. It's just absolute, perfect deliciousness."
choice_data_list: I see... How do you want it seasoned?
I see... How do you want to season it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Lightly salted is great,
and teriyaki is delicious too, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I think I'll enjoy it just as it is, with the sauce that comes with it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The manufacturers put a lot
of careful thought into creating the best flavor, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eating it just like this is the best!
Now, let's dig in!

Something made with such perfection needs no gimmicks.
Alongside Narita Top Road,
I enjoyed a truly classic, authentic flavor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I did it!
I got pretty lucky there, huh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With this many carrots,
I could make all sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Want to stock up
on carrot sticks together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Raw ones, of course, but also crispy baked ones,
and ones fried like karinto.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eating this between training sessions is packed
with nutrition! Supplements are good too,
but have this along with them!
choice_data_list: T-They sure look like they're having fun...
T-They sure look like they're having fun...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, to tell you the truth... rather than tablet supplements,
I really do prefer carrots after all,
personally...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be good for your health too, Trainer!
Could you help me with the prep?

Narita Top Road, being quite the naturalist.
Afterwards, the two of them diligently
made carrot sticks and ate them.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Only one carrot...? Well, I suppose it is better than a consolation prize, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still! I guess that's how it goes.
Thank you very much, I'll gladly accept."
choice_data_list: That was a fast recovery, huh!?
That was a fast recovery, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, you could say I'm used to it,
or that it's just business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly blessed with good luck. But
something like this is just about right, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When your luck is weak, it just means you have to
make up for it through your own hard work!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sorry... If only I had a little more luck on my side, I could have made things easier for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you from now on, too!
Let's share this carrot!

Even if the results weren't great,
Narita Top Road didn't get discouraged.
Together, the two of them vigorously munched on carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Tissues... I use them a lot so they won't go to waste,
but still... uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what was it that went wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Was it the timing of when I started turning it?
Or maybe I should have put more strength into turning it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Please instruct me!
What was the absolute worst part—?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Luck... If it's just that, there's nothing we can do.
There's not even a way to reflect on it...

Even if you change your approach, some things just can't be fixed.
Narita Top Road hung her head in dejection.
